response.original_title: How do I add passengers to my MSC Cruise?
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing MSC Cruise reservation, you must call MSC Customer Service directly at 1-855-732-4023 (US) or contact your original travel agent, as additions cannot be completed online or through the mobile app.  Requirements for Adding Passengers  Cabin Capacity: Your current stateroom must be rated and equipped (such as having a sofa bed or upper Pullman) to fit the extra person. If it is not rated for extra guests, you may need to upgrade to a larger room, subject to availability.  Ship & Lifeboat Limits: The total ship capacity and the specific lifeboat section cannot be completely sold out.  Pricing: The addition will be re-priced at the current, prevailing fare rate rather than your original booking rate.  Information Needed: Have the new passenger's full legal name, date of birth, and payment details ready when you call.
